description: Dylan Field and Adobe executives discussed possible partnership or combination; Figma declined to continue acquisition discussions at that time.

description: Field and Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen discussed a potential acquisition; Figma again declined to continue at that time.
outcome: No transaction pursued.

description: Adobe executives David Wadhwani and Scott Belsky asked Field about discussing an acquisition; Field was open to understanding terms.
outcome: Active acquisition talks resumed.

description: Parties entered a confidentiality agreement and Figma began providing confidential information to Adobe.
outcome: Due diligence process advanced.

description: Adobe delivered a $20B non-binding proposal, approximately half cash and half stock; this proposal did not include a termination fee.
outcome: Figma continued negotiations and sought higher value.

description: Figma counterproposed a reverse termination fee if the transaction failed to close due to failure to receive required antitrust approvals.
outcome: Termination-fee mechanism entered negotiations.

description: Adobe's revised proposal kept the $20B acquisition price and agreed to a $1B reverse termination fee.
outcome: Core fee term fixed before definitive agreement.

description: Parties submitted a joint response arguing their activities were complementary and the deal pro-competitive.

notes: Statement of Objections is not a final decision.

case_name: Anticipated acquisition of Figma by Adobe
description: CMA published provisional findings and possible-remedies notice identifying three provisional SLCs and considering prohibition or structural divestiture.

outcome: Proposed acquisition abandoned; $1B contractual fee became payable under agreed termination terms.

description: Companies publicly announced abandonment, stating there was no clear path to necessary EC and CMA regulatory approvals.
outcome: Companies continued independently.

description: Antitrust AAG Jonathan Kanter publicly welcomed abandonment and thanked DOJ staff who investigated the merger.
outcome: Official U.S. investigation record confirms abandonment; no court prohibition in this source.

description: Abandonment ended the Commission's in-depth investigation.
